## About
For many years we've worked to give our customers quality service, and they've shown their appreciation by coming back to us repeatedly. We want to be the shop you trust for all your car's maintenance and repair needs.
Our mechanics are skilled and experienced, and most of all they love cars and care about yours. Most people don't find car repair fun or convenient, so we try to make the whole process as easy as we can. We may not be related, but you'll feel like family here.

## Services
- Check engine light: If your check engine light comes on, bring it in. One reviewer said we were very accommodating when theirs came on.
- State of the art diagnostics: We use modern diagnostic equipment to find out what's wrong. One reviewer mentioned it on their Chevy Spark.
- Inspection: Bring your car in for an inspection and see how we work.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Can I reach you by email?
A: Yes, you can email us at cnccarrepair@gmail.com.
